text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the intense Shuka Sho, Daiwa Scarlet reveals more growth than Vodka and takes the win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Daiwa Scarlet makes a show of telling Vodka that she'll be defeating her again at the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before walking off, she tells Vodka she will also be running in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup before the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Feeling that she's not progressing as well as Daiwa Scarlet, who always has a clear goal, Vodka decides to run in the Arima Kinen as well.
